gloss: to differ, to conflict, to be at odds

definitions.gloss: to differ, to conflict, to be at odds
definitions.explanation: For statements, accounts, opinions, or facts to be inconsistent or contradictory with each other.

examples.japanese: {意見|いけん}が{食|く}い{違|ちが}った。
{二人|ふたり}の{証言|しょうげん}が{食|く}い{違|ちが}っている。
examples.english: The testimonies of the two people are inconsistent.

examples.japanese: {計画|けいかく}と{実際|じっさい}の{結果|けっか}が{大|おお}きく{食|く}い{違|ちが}うことがある。
examples.english: The plan and the actual results can differ significantly.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {意見|いけん}が{食|く}い{違|ちが}う: opinions differ
- {証言|しょうげん}が{食|く}い{違|ちが}う: testimonies conflict
- {話|はなし}が{食|く}い{違|ちが}う: stories don't match
- {事実|じじつ}と{食|く}い{違|ちが}う: to conflict with the facts

RELATED NOUN:
- {食|く}い{違|ちが}い: discrepancy, disagreement

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {異|こと}なる: to differ (more neutral, less confrontational)
- {矛盾|むじゅん}する: to contradict (stronger; implies logical impossibility)
